latin_iast: tā (arthāt e kitāvake) āmarā sahaja kare diyaechi
latin_ascii: ta (arthat e kitavake) amara sahaja kare diyaechi

latin_iast: evaṃ yena tomarā sandhāna karate pāra
latin_ascii: evam yena tomara sandhana karate para

latin_iast: āra tomarā asvīkāra karacha (tave ki pariṇati have)
latin_ascii: ara tomara asvikara karacha (tave ki parinati have)

latin_iast: (e panthā niyaechena) yāte tini parīkṣā karate pārena
latin_ascii: (e pantha niyaechena) yate tini pariksa karate parena

latin_iast: tini acirei tāderake paricālita karavena sat pathe
latin_ascii: tini acirei taderake paricalita karavena sat pathe

latin_iast: evaṃ tomādera parīkṣā karava āmarā avaśyai
latin_ascii: evam tomadera pariksa karava amara avasyai

latin_iast: evaṃ acirei tini vinaṣṭa kare divena
latin_ascii: evam acirei tini vinasta kare divena

latin_iast: evaṃ tā~ra (arthāt āllāhara) pavitratā ghoṣaṇā kara
latin_ascii: evam ta~ra (arthat allahara) pavitrata ghosana kara

latin_iast: tādera sāthe tomādera yuddha karate have
latin_ascii: tadera sathe tomadera yuddha karate have

latin_iast: tomāra kāche vāẏa'āta grahaṇa kare tārā
latin_ascii: tomara kache vaya'ata grahana kare tara

latin_iast: yāte tomarā eke aparera sāthe paricita hate pāra
latin_ascii: yate tomara eke aparera sathe paricita hate para

latin_iast: āmarā tave akṣama haẏe par̤echi ki
latin_ascii: amara tave aksama haye parechi ki

latin_iast: tārā paraspare ki parāmarśa kare niyaeche
latin_ascii: tara paraspare ki paramarsa kare niyaeche

latin_iast: evaṃ tāderake āmarā veśi kare deva
latin_ascii: evam taderake amara vesi kare deva

latin_iast: (tā car̤e gopana khavara) tārā śune neẏa
latin_ascii: (ta care gopana khavara) tara sune neya

latin_iast: tāderake śāstira madhye nikṣepa karā have
latin_ascii: taderake sastira madhye niksepa kara have

latin_iast: ataḥpara tāra pavitra mahimā ghoṣaṇā karo
latin_ascii: atahpara tara pavitra mahima ghosana karo

latin_iast: tāra sāthe tomarā ekhana ki tarka karacha
latin_ascii: tara sathe tomara ekhana ki tarka karacha

latin_iast: (he navī) ataeva mukha phirāo/ upekṣā karo
latin_ascii: (he navi) ataeva mukha phirao/ upeksa karo

latin_iast: ataeva tumi tādera prati lakṣya rākha
latin_ascii: ataeva tumi tadera prati laksya rakha

latin_iast: tā āmarā pariṇata karate pāri avaśyai
latin_ascii: ta amara parinata karate pari avasyai

latin_iast: ataḥpara khiẏānata karechila ubhaẏe tādera du'janera
latin_ascii: atahpara khiyanata karechila ubhaye tadera du'janera

latin_iast: śīghraẏa āmarā tādera krame krame niẏe yāva
latin_ascii: sighraya amara tadera krame krame niye yava

latin_iast: evaṃ āmarā tomāke sahaja kare divo
latin_ascii: evam amara tomake sahaja kare divo

latin_iast: āra tā pāśa kāṭāve/ upekṣā karave
latin_ascii: ara ta pasa katave/ upeksa karave

latin_iast: o tāra pāni pāna karāya (vādhā dio nā)"
latin_ascii: o tara pani pana karaya (vadha dio na)"

latin_iast: evaṃ e theke dūre rākhā have
latin_ascii: evam e theke dure rakha have

latin_iast: evaṃ tā vāravāra gaṇanā kare rekheche
latin_ascii: evam ta varavara ganana kare rekheche
